_ordering_rationale: PV decroissante : Instruments & Accessories (revenu razor/blade recurrent par procedure, joyau ISRG), da Vinci procedures (driver volume sous-jacent), Installed Base systems (asset base monetisable), Services revenue, Operating Lease (modele evolution).

kpis.signal: Razor/blade pur, recurrent par procedure, joyau ISRG, marges premium
kpis.description_fr: Revenu Instruments & Accessoires : consommables par procedure da Vinci/Ion. Modele razor/blade pur, lie aux ~2.7M procedures FY24. Joyau du business model ISRG.
kpis.description_en: Instruments & Accessories revenue: per-procedure consumables da Vinci/Ion. Pure razor/blade model, tied to ~2.7M procedures FY24. ISRG business model jewel.

kpis.signal: CAGR 5 ans +13.9%, hypercroissance soutenue robotique chirurgicale
kpis.description_fr: CA total Intuitive Surgical = Instruments + Systemes + Services + Operating Lease. Hypercroissance robotique. Recurring revenue (Instruments + Services + Op Lease) = 84% du CA FY24 (vs 79% FY22).
kpis.description_en: Total Intuitive Surgical revenue = Instruments + Systems + Services + Operating Lease. Robotic surgery hypergrowth. Recurring revenue (Instruments + Services + Op Lease) = 84% revenue FY24 (vs 79% FY22).

kpis.signal: Base installee record FY24, monetisation razor/blade quasi monopolistique en robotique chirurgicale
kpis.description_fr: Base installee da Vinci au 31/12/2024 : 9902 systemes (5807 US, 1867 Europe, 1745 Asie, 483 RoW). +Ion = 805 systemes. Asset base de monetisation razor/blade.
kpis.description_en: da Vinci installed base at 12/31/2024: 9902 systems (5807 US, 1867 Europe, 1745 Asia, 483 RoW). Plus Ion = 805 systems. Razor/blade monetization asset base.

kpis.signal: Revenu recurrent service contracts sur base installee, croissance soutenue
kpis.description_fr: Revenu Services : maintenance/service contracts da Vinci/Ion. Recurrent, lie a la croissance de la base installee.
kpis.description_en: Services Revenue: da Vinci/Ion maintenance/service contracts. Recurring, tied to installed base growth.

kpis.signal: Croissance >30%/an, shift modele financement leasing (309 fixed + 467 usage-based FY24)
kpis.description_fr: Revenu Operating Lease : systemes places en leasing (309 fixed + 467 usage-based FY24). Modele en mutation vers leasing, recurrent croissant.
kpis.description_en: Operating Lease Revenue: systems placed under leases (309 fixed + 467 usage-based FY24). Business model shifting to leasing, growing recurring.

_notes: Historique 5 ans FY20-FY24 pour Instruments, Total, Services, Op Lease. Installed Base uniquement FY24 confirme (historique non disponible sans risque d'invention - 10-K anciens donnent only US/OUS placements annuels). Sources : 10-K SEC Intuitive Surgical MD&A 2022-2025.
